integrity: Complete analytical proof of the long-edge continuum formula and finite exact-rational corroboration; the previously known short-edge weighted-cycle result is explicitly excluded from novelty. General cube-section priority remains a bibliographic risk; no external attestation is asserted.
previous_scientific_review: Initial mathematical assessment retained in source history; its originality claim was narrowed after an overlapping published theorem was identified.
scientific_limitations: The substantive finding concerns real Lipschitz-free four-cycle spaces with weights (1,1,1,t) only for 1<t<3. The 0<t<=1 exact formula is prior published mathematics, and the t=3 tree endpoint is classical. No complex, multiweight, higher-cycle or uniqueness-of-all-optimal-ellipsoids conclusion is drawn.
title: Exact Euclidean distortion on the long-edge deformation of a four-cycle
